I've written the round-271 task and the decision is **CONTINUE**. Round 271 is **SABA-B-11c stage 2: relative snap**, the option Saba chose on 2026-10-30. I made no changes to the store, which is still clean at `4b912a9`. The advisor was available and I consulted it before the design and again at the end.

**Round 270 closed.**
- C passed it (16 rows, browser-verified, 0 bugs) and gate 270 published `4b912a9`, which is the baseline for round 271.
- I closed GATE266-S1, B-R269-DETAIL-ALLTRACKS-DROP, GATE266-S4, B-R266-CLIPS-SPLIT-COPY, and the older signal that GATE266-S1 replaced.
- The previous task is archived as `tasks/round-270.md`, an identical copy.
- The gate-270 review findings and C's/A's notes became 6 deferred Lows (455 in total), one architecture signal (keep, optional pure helper), one retro candidate and a note on the existing detail-panel candidate.

**What round 271 changes**
- **The bug, confirmed in the browser at HEAD at both sizes:** with Snap on, a 5 px jitter on a clip at 10.300 s jumps it to 10.000 s and adds an Undo entry. This is F1-ABSOLUTE-SNAP.
- **The fix:** a clip that sits off the grid keeps its offset and moves in whole grid steps (10.3 → 11.3 → 12.3) when dragged alone, as a group, or onto another lane. Clips already on the grid behave exactly as before. Edge snapping to other clips and markers works as today.
- **Musical grids:** the offset is measured from the grid line, so it does not drift over repeated drags.
- **Unchanged on purpose:** arrow-key nudge, trims, time selections, the loop brace and library drops. Saba's answer covered drags only.
- **Snap tooltip:** "clips land on the grid" was no longer true, so it becomes "Snap on — clips follow the grid (G)" (product-designer's wording).
- **Saved projects:** an off-grid clip dragged with Snap on no longer jumps to the nearest line. I recorded this as D-29z587.

**Pre-check on a scratch copy**
- Type check and Biome are clean.
- Across 168 test files, the code change alone breaks exactly 7 tests. All 7 are granted rewrites, each with an equal or stronger replacement. With the rewrites, all 2519 tests pass.
- 8 named mutants each turn their rows red.
- Every C browser row was run on both HEAD and the sketch at both window sizes, with 0 page errors. On the sketch, a jitter leaves the clip at 10.300 and a group drag gives 11.300 / 16.000 (HEAD gives 12.000 / 16.700).

**For Saba (not blocking round 271)**, in `user-review/questions-11c-stage2.md`:
- **SABA-Q-11C-NUDGE:** should the arrow-key nudge also keep the offset?
- **SABA-Q-11C-REALIGN:** relative snap gives no snapped way back onto the grid, and a drag to the left stops at the offset (0.3 s) instead of 0. Product-designer's suggestion is to make the song start a magnetic edge.

I also wrote a measurement request for root to run in Live 12 (`user-review/live-checks.md`). The Live manual (§6.7/6.9/6.10) says nothing about off-grid clips.

**Order after this:** 272 is SYS-6, unless the regression round comes due (on or after 2026-11-02) and goes first. The retro is at round 275. No frontend-architect checkpoint is needed: no file has a run of repeated structural changes, and this round's code change is two files.
